name: amiberry
description: TLS properly enforced, but SHA-256 comes from a server-supplied SHA256SUMS asset and fails open if that asset is missing.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Amiberry’s updater supports comparison with SHA-256 metadata supplied by a release. The check is conditional on an expected digest being available; independent publisher authentication and release-specific policy remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study release.
The cited source establishes a checksum control only; it does not establish publisher signatures or the complete released artifact channel.
